subject: criminology
intro: Criminology leads into the criminal justice workforce — policing, investigation, probation and forensic science, together with the research that studies crime as a social fact.

roles.title: Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers
roles.entry: High school diploma or equivalent plus academy training
roles.what: Maintain order and protect life and property by enforcing laws: patrol an area, respond to calls, direct traffic, investigate accidents and apprehend and arrest suspects.
roles.where: The Crime Scene to Courtroom unit — the personnel involved in criminal investigations — is the patrol officer's part of the system, and Changing Awareness of Crime, especially why crimes go unreported, shapes what officers actually encounter.

roles.title: Detectives and Criminal Investigators
roles.entry: High school diploma or equivalent plus police experience
roles.what: Conduct investigations into suspected violations of federal, state or local laws, building cases from evidence, interviews and records to prevent or solve crimes.
roles.where: Crime Scene to Courtroom is the detective's workflow in course form: gathering evidence, meeting the CPS requirements for prosecuting suspects, and reviewing criminal cases to test whether a file will stand up.

roles.title: Probation Officers and Correctional Treatment Specialists
roles.what: Provide social services that help rehabilitate law offenders in custody or on probation or parole, and make recommendations that shape rehabilitation plans and conditions of release.
roles.where: The Crime and Punishment unit — forms of social control, the role of agencies, and the aims, funding and philosophy of the criminal justice agencies — is the institutional map a probation officer works inside.

roles.title: Forensic Science Technicians
roles.what: Collect, identify, classify and analyse physical evidence from crime scenes, run tests on weapons and substances, and testify as expert witnesses about laboratory findings.
roles.where: Crime Scene to Courtroom follows the evidence from scene to prosecution, so the course's study of investigation personnel and case review is exactly the chain of custody forensic technicians sit at the start of.

roles.title: Sociologists
roles.what: Study human society and social behaviour, examining the groups, institutions and organisations people form and how group activities shape individual members' lives.
roles.where: The Theories of criminality unit — sociological theories and the social construction of criminality — plus Changing Awareness of Crime's media representation and crime statistics are sociology of crime in practice.
